description: This file defines a VideoService class responsible for managing video detection jobs, handling uploads, simulating processing, broadcasting status updates, and tracking job states within a FastAPI-based application.

classes.name: VideoService
classes.description: Service layer for video detection jobs, handling upload processing, job management, and broadcasting updates.

methods.name: __init__(self, upload_dir: str, output_dir: str, ws_manager)
methods.description: Initializes the VideoService with directories and websocket manager.

methods.name: str _save_upload(self, file: UploadFile)
methods.description: Saves uploaded video file to disk and returns the file path.

methods.name: VideoJobResponse start_job(self, file: UploadFile, confidence: float = 0.5, model_name: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Starts a new video detection job, saving the upload, creating output paths, and initializing job state.

methods.name: _process_job(self, job_id: str, confidence: float)
methods.description: Simulates processing of the video job, broadcasting status updates, and creating placeholder output.

methods.name: VideoStatusResponse status(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the current status and details of a given job.

ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, upload_dir: str, output_dir: str, ws_manager):$/

ctags.name: _process_job
ctags.pattern: /^    async def _process_job(self, job_id: str, confidence: float):$/

ctags.pattern: /^    async def start_job(self, file: UploadFile, confidence: float = 0.5, model_name: Optional[st/
ctags.signature: (self, file: UploadFile, confidence: float = 0.5, model_name: Optional[str] = None)

ctags.pattern: /^    async def status(self, job_id: str) -> VideoStatusResponse:$/
